EZMB_TEMPORARY.title: Temporary
EZMB_TEMPORARY.description: This card only exists during this combat. It is removed after combat.
EZMB_PLANTED.title: Plant
EZMB_PLANTED.description: Seedbed catches an eligible card before it enters your hand, removes it from this combat, and gives you 1 Withered Husk. Planting is not playing, discarding, or exhausting, so those triggers do not fire. Planted Temporary Status and Curse cards do not return this combat; this is not permanent card removal, and permanent Curses cannot be planted. A planted Blight Sprout is treated as handled without counting as played and adds no Rootblight I after combat. A planted Rootblight only freezes for this combat: it remains in your master deck at the same level and does not upgrade, split, get removed, or downgrade after combat.
